properties.smsText: Some bus services in Sydney’s Eastern Suburbs, Northern Beaches, lower North Shore and inner north-west may be affected by industrial action.
properties.speechText:
Some services may be affected by industrial action which involves drivers not operating certain vehicles.  
 
Buses may be delayed or cancelled and there may be longer wait times and crowding at major interchanges.  
 
On Friday 13 November, bus services may be significantly disrupted due to industrial action. Work stoppages may take place between 6:30–7.30am and 5–6pm, with potential delays before and after. 
 
Bus operators and the RTBU are engaged in intensive negotiations in a bid to avoid the proposed industrial action proceeding on Friday. 
 
In case the action goes ahead, passengers are advised to plan ahead. Use alternative transport where available, travel at a different time if you can, and allow extra travel time. 
 
If the action proceeds, bus services are expected to be severely disrupted during the stoppages, with widespread cancellations likely.
 
Impacts are also expected in the hour before and after each stoppage as services wind down and progressively return to normal.

Lift access to the station will be available on the opposite side on Railway Road. The ramp between Bank Street and Platform 2 will be available to enter and exit the station.

If you need lift access to Platform 2 or Bank Street from the concourse, catch a train from Platform 1 and change at Rhodes Station to return via Platform 2.

Customers on Bank Street or Platform 2 that need lift access to the concourse will need to catch a train from Platform 2 and change at Eastwood Station to return via Platform 1.

If you need further assistance, ask station staff or call 02 9752 8460.
